title: Verify: Preload planning and missing-asset fallback unit tests
summary: Prove planner dedupe, missing reporting and fallback resolution.
description: Pure unit tests over an in-memory manifest object; no filesystem.
acceptance_criteria: Given refs with a duplicate and a ghost id, the plan loads one entry and reports the ghost as missing
Given a missing, undefined or failed-to-load asset id, resolveTextureKey returns the fallback key and never throws
technical_constraints: Manifest built inline via parseManifest, no disk access

steps.action: Create manifest with assets 'objects/bed' and 'objects/door' via parseManifest; assert refs ['objects/bed','objects/bed','objects/ghost'] give load of one entry 'objects/bed' and missing ['objects/ghost'].
steps.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/preload.test.ts

steps.action: Assert resolveTextureKey returns FALLBACK_ASSET_ID for a missing id, for undefined, and for a planned id absent from loadedKeys, and returns the id when planned and loaded; assert none throw.
steps.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/preload.test.ts
